env.up: v=0 is up (zenith), v=0.5 horizon, v=1 nadir
env.dir_to_uv: camera space d (x right, y up, z towards viewer): u = 0.5 + atan2(d.x, -d.z) / (2*pi), v = 0.5 - asin(d.y) / pi
env.origin: bubble position, 1.2 m in front of the camera, 12 cm above the lens axis; same orientation as the main camera

color: sRGB display-referred (Blender AgX view transform baked in); misty pastel spring morning
note: Dawn: the low sun (8 deg up, 3 deg left of the lens axis) is hidden behind thin mist, so there is no hard disc: 'sun' is the centre of a soft creamy glow (peach-white) and 'sun_dir' points from the bubble towards it in camera space. Use a soft, broad, warm-white highlight (about 0.5 of the golden sun, wider). The sky is pale peach-pink at the horizon going to lavender overhead; env.jpg holds pastel sky, blossom trees and a dewy lawn with a few tiny glints.
